rust_summary: the `/lua` console's reads and writes on the level in place: the ids a selector names, an entity's data and name, a write of that data, a command run as the world's owner, and the dimension of the level in place.
doc_summary: `select_ids(selector)` are the ids the entities a selector names have, as the owner's command finds them; `entity_data_in_place(id)` is the entity's data as `/data get entity` prints it; `set_entity_data(id, tag)` writes it back; `entity_name_in_place(id)` is its name as plain text; `run_command_as_owner(line)` runs a command as the world's owner and returns the chat replies; `level_dimension()` is the dimension of the level in place. Bundles need "hooks": @API:lua_console_helpers@.
